column1: Example of a Well Written IDP Goal

column2: Become an active contributor in planning and pre-planning meetings by identifying gaps, risks, dependencies, and solution options before work begins.
column3: Intermittently proficient in contributions before work begins.
column4: Review all user stories before planning meetings. Document questions, acceptance criteria gaps, technical risks, and possible solutions. Meet with manager or tech lead before key planning sessions to validate findings and align on recommendations. Contribute at least one meaningful clarification, risk, or solution in each planning discussion.
column5: Provide feedback on the quality of pre-planning analysis. Help identify high-value areas to focus on before meetings. Coach on how to raise risks and recommendations clearly and confidently with the team.
